name: The Forge
purpose: A cloning lab + masterclass for setting Claude Code (and alt AI providers) on their way, training your own files/preferences, and cloning software from medium to massive.

backup.//levels: Minimum generations kept per sensitive file. Spec asked for >= 3. Higher is safer; older generations beyond this are pruned.
backup.//sensitive_globs_file: Line-based glob list (relative to forge root) of files treated as sensitive/personalized/time-valuable.
backup.//snapshot_on_change_only: Skip a snapshot when content is byte-identical to the newest one (avoids churn).

cloning.//ladder: The scale ladder the Forge trains you up. See doctrine/CLONING_LADDER.md.

providers.//note: The technique is provider-agnostic; primary is Claude Code. See doctrine/PROVIDERS.md.
